story_type: crew waits on the pad while their target rocket is lost after launch, mission scrubbed
hook: They were sealed in, waiting on a rocket that never made orbit.
narration: Two astronauts were sealed in their capsule, waiting on a rocket that never made it to orbit.
October 1965. Gemini 6 was going to chase down and dock with an Agena target.
Wally Schirra and Tom Stafford were already in their spacecraft on the pad.
A few miles away, the Agena lifted off on top of an Atlas booster.
The Agena had to reach orbit first, so the Gemini could launch behind it and catch up.
[short pause] About six minutes into the flight, the telemetry signals were lost.
outcome: The Agena never reached orbit, and the Gemini 6 launch was scrubbed.
title: Their docking target vanished, 1965
description:
In October 1965, Gemini 6 astronauts Wally Schirra and Tom Stafford were already in their spacecraft when the Agena target vehicle launched on an Atlas booster. Telemetry was lost about six minutes into flight, the Agena never reached orbit, and the Gemini 6 launch was scrubbed.
